SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
PASSAIC COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000988
DOCKET NO. F 10562 25 CTL #163207
PLAINTIFF – PEOPLES SECURITY BANK & TRUST COMPANY
DEFENDANTS- YEC CONSULTING, LLC
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 22nd DAY OF September 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Commissioner’s Meeting Room, Room 220 Administration Building, 401 Grand Street, Paterson, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the City of Paterson, County of Passaic and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: Tax Lot 1 C101 Block 8503
Nearest Cross Street: E. 30th Street
Dimensions (approx): N/A
Upset Amount: $1,390,715.77 with interest continuing to accrue from March 30, 2026 at $421.99 per diem
Occupancy Status: Unknown
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Office of the Passaic County Clerk/Register on April 7, 2022 in Book M17926, Page 1, et seq., and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Passaic County
The sale is further subject to restrictions, reversions, reservations, and easements of record, if any, including the: (1) Master Deed for 680 Broadway Condominium (the “Condominium”) effective as of June 9, 2009 and recorded November 6, 2009 in Book D1842, Page 1 with the Passaic County Clerk’s Office; as corrected by Corrective Master Deed for 680 Broadway Condominium dated February 22, 2010 and recorded March 1, 2010 in Book D1887, Page 197; as amended by First Amendment recorded September 22, 2010 in Book D1975, Page 105, Second Amendment recorded January 13, 2015 in Book D2576, Page 15, and Third Amendment recorded February 16, 2017 in Book D2999, Page 231 (collectively, the “Master Deed”); (2) Amended and Restated By-Laws of 680 Broadway Condominium Association, Inc. (the “By-Laws”); (3) Ground Leases for Block 8503, Lots 1, 23 and 24 (collectively, the “Barnert Heirs Property”), each dated January 12, 2009, between Barnert Hospital Life Trustees for the benefit of the Barnert Heirs, a trust (the “Barnert Heirs”), as landlord, and Community Healthcare Associates LLC (“CHA”), as tenant (memorandum of which was recorded on November 6, 2009, in Book D1841, Page 270) (collectively, the “CHA Ground Lease”); and (4) Ground Lease for the Barnert Heirs Property and Block 8502, Lot 2, and Block 8503, Lots 209, 25, 39 and 40, and dated June 9, 2009 between CHA, as landlord, and Barnert Management, LLC (“Sponsor”), as tenant (memorandum of which was recorded on November 6, 2009 in Book D1841, Page 289), as amended by First Amendment to Ground Lease dated February 14, 2012 (memorandum of which was recorded in Book D1261, Page 231) and Second Amendment to Ground Lease dated March 8, 2013 (memorandum of which was recorded in Book D2290, Page 260) (collectively, the “Sponsor Ground Lease” together with the CHA Ground Lease, the “Ground Leases”).
Said Premises is a Leasehold Condominium and is subject to the Ground Leases which are for a term of 99 years; the CHA Ground Lease expires on January 11, 2108 and the Sponsor Ground Lease expires on January 20, 2108.
Said Premises is subject to a use restriction requiring that it be used for healthcare services only.
The sale is subject to that certain tax sale certificate # 26-00896, recorded February 10, 2026 in book M19794, page 91, which is held by RTLF-NJ IIB, LLC. The amount due under this tax sale certificate can be obtained from the local taxing authority.
The sale may be subject to unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water, and sewer liens and other municipal assessments. Any amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
680 BROADWAY UNIT 1A Paterson, NJ 07515
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Passaic County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Passaic County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $1,414,260.54 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Thomas Adamo
SHERIFF
Advertised in the Passaic County Sheriff Website
DATED: August 31, 2026
SHERMAN ATLAS SYLVESTER & STAMELMAN, LLP
210 PARK Avenue
2ND FLOOR
FLORHAM PARK, NJ 07932
